verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state @coderabbitai review performs incremental review of new changes (not repeating a full review), distinct from full review, and CodeRabbit tracks resolved comments and syncs review decisions via the request-changes workflow as feedback is addressed. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that old comments are specifically not repeated after fixes, and detail on exactly how 'fixed' comments are marked resolved across pushes.
